creative_direction: Place a small timber chalet in an open alpine meadow at sunrise, with its roof catching muted gold light. A low stone wall and a few grasses provide foreground texture, while distant snowy peaks rise through thin mist. Keep the house unoccupied and free of visible lettering. Use painterly realism with soft atmospheric transitions, leaving ample pale peach-blue sky above the mountains for a calm phone layout. Vertical 1024x1536 for a phone wallpaper. Keep the upper 20% naturally quiet for the clock, with no lettering, logos, or watermark.
